rec: 2022 congressional plan (H.B. 384, signed by Gov. Reeves Jan. 24, 2022)

All About Redistricting, Mississippi (court plan Dec. 30, 2011; JR 1 and JR 201 passed May 2-3, 2012; JR 202 of Mar. 27, 2019; HB 384 signed Jan. 24, 2022; JR 1 and JR 202 of Mar. 31, 2022) - secondary

Four districts, used in 2022 and 2024. The court's May 23, 2022 opinion in Smith v. Hosemann rejected challenges to this plan (appeal dismissed as Buck v. Watson, 2023). Census file basis: the Bureau documents its 2022 legislative files as the plans collected for the 2022 election year, and the 118th Congress files as the plans the states submitted for that Congress. Compared on documents only: the cached Census folder held only the 2024 vintage when this was checked, so the 2020 and 2022 files were not opened. Sources are secondary (the legislature's bill page could not be reached).
